# The design records that step 1 of scripts/check.sh checks: one line per record, naming
# a JSON design file, the .lean file of the library that scripts/gen_design.py generates
# from it, and the name of the definition in that file.
#
# Step 1 fails unless every JSON file in designs/ is named here, each named .lean file is,
# byte for byte, what gen_design.py generates from its JSON file under that name, and no
# other .lean file of the library begins with the header of a generated file. So the
# records are identified by this list, not by what a file says about itself.
# To add a design record: add its JSON file, generate its .lean file, add a line here.
designs/illustrative-1v8.json  VoltageToBit/Examples/IllustrativeDesign.lean  illustrative
